nss.whoWeAre.label: Profile
nss.whoWeAre.subtitle: Born from a vision of selfless service, we transform ordinary students into extraordinary nation-builders.
nss.whoWeAre.para1: National Service Scheme (NSS) — India's largest voluntary youth organization. Launched on 24th September, 1969 — the birth centenary of Mahatma Gandhi — we were created with one powerful purpose: to develop the personality of students through community service.
nss.whoWeAre.para2: Under the Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports, Government of India, we operate across thousands of colleges and universities, empowering young minds to serve the nation while building leadership, discipline, and empathy.
nss.whoWeAre.para3: Our motto — "Not Me But You" — captures the essence of democratic living: the welfare of others before self. This is not just a slogan for us; it is a way of life.
nss.whoWeAre.fact3Value: Youth Affairs & Sports, Govt. of India
nss.whoWeAre.fact4Value: 8 spokes of the Konark Wheel — 24 hours of selfless service
nss.whatWeDo.label: Our Mission
nss.whatWeDo.heading: This is What
nss.whatWeDo.subtitle: We don't just talk about change — we create it. Here's how we serve our community, our nation, and our future.
nss.whatWeDo.card1Desc: Blood donation drives, health awareness programmes, village adoption, and door-to-door welfare campaigns that touch lives directly.
nss.whatWeDo.card2Desc: Tree plantation drives, cleanliness campaigns, waste management initiatives, and building an eco-conscious generation.
nss.whatWeDo.card3Desc: Teaching underprivileged children, digital literacy workshops, and awareness campaigns that break the cycle of ignorance.
nss.whatWeDo.card4Desc: Emergency response during floods, earthquakes, and pandemics — NSS volunteers are always among the first to arrive.
nss.whatWeDo.card5Desc: Swachh Bharat Abhiyan, sanitation drives, health camps, and spreading awareness about preventive healthcare.
nss.whatWeDo.card6Desc: Cultural exchange programmes, unity rallies, and campaigns against discrimination — building one India, together.
nss.giveGet.label: The Exchange
nss.giveGet.heading: What Happens When
nss.giveGet.headingAccent: You Join As a NSS Volunteer
nss.giveGet.subtitle: It's a two-way journey. You invest in us, and we invest in your transformation. Here's what the exchange looks like.
nss.giveGet.give1: Your time, energy, and compassion — the most powerful gifts you own.
nss.giveGet.give2: Minimum 120 hours of community service spread across 2 years.
nss.giveGet.give3: Active participation in camps, rallies, cleanliness drives, and social programmes.
nss.giveGet.give4: Your unique skills — whether it's teaching, organizing, creating, or leading.
nss.giveGet.get1: UGC-recognized certificate and grace marks on your academic record.
nss.giveGet.get2: Leadership, teamwork, communication, and real-world problem-solving skills.
nss.giveGet.get3: A powerful network of like-minded changemakers and lifelong friends.
nss.giveGet.get4: Priority weightage in government jobs, competitive exams, and higher education.
nss.giveGet.get5: Memories, experiences, and a sense of purpose that transforms your entire life.
nss.bbCollege.label: Our College
nss.bbCollege.heading: Life at Banwarilal Bhalotia
nss.bbCollege.subtitle: This is where the action happens. Here's what makes our NSS unit at BB College, Asansol, truly special.
nss.bbCollege.card1Desc: Every year, we organize an annual 7-day residential special camp where volunteers live, learn, and serve together in adopted villages. It's the highlight of our NSS calendar — a life-changing experience of community living and service.
nss.bbCollege.card2Desc: From NSS Day (24th September) to Republic Day, Gandhi Jayanti to International Yoga Day, World Environment Day to National Youth Day — we celebrate every occasion that inspires service and patriotism.
nss.bbCollege.card3Desc: Regular blood donation camps organized on campus, saving hundreds of lives in Asansol and surrounding areas. Our volunteers lead by example — rolling up their sleeves for those in need.
nss.bbCollege.card4Desc: Cleanliness drives across campus and surrounding communities, keeping Mahatma Gandhi's vision of a clean India alive. Every broom we pick up is a step towards a better tomorrow.
nss.bbCollege.card5Desc: Taking to the streets to spread awareness on critical issues — health, environment, gender equality, substance abuse, and social harmony. Our voice reaches where textbooks cannot.
nss.bbCollege.card6Desc: Reaching underprivileged communities with education, healthcare essentials, and emotional support. We believe service is not charity — it is our responsibility as future citizens.
nss.history.label: Our History
nss.history.heading: Why NSS
nss.history.subtitle: We were born from a simple belief — that the youth of this nation can build the India of tomorrow, one act of service at a time.
nss.history.desc1: NSS was launched by the Government of India on 24th September, 1969 — the birth centenary of Mahatma Gandhi. It started with 37 universities covering 40,000 students.
nss.history.desc2: To develop student personality through community service, bridge the gap between educated youth and rural communities, and instil a sense of social responsibility.
nss.history.desc3: From 37 universities in 1969 to over 40,000+ NSS units across India today. Over 40 lakh student volunteers actively serve the nation every single year.
nss.history.desc4: NSS continues to be India's most powerful platform for youth empowerment. Every camp, every drive, every act of service adds to a legacy that began with one simple belief.
nss.cta.heading: Your Journey of Service
nss.cta.subtitle: Join our NSS family at Banwarilal Bhalotia College and be the change you want to see. Every great transformation begins with a single step — take yours today.

nss.spotlight.title: Krishan Kumar Gupta
nss.spotlight.subtitle: The First NSS Volunteer of India
nss.spotlight.desc: Formally recognized as India's very first NSS volunteer, Mr. K.K. Gupta enrolled during the historic first orientation camp at Rajghat, Kirori Mal College (University of Delhi) in June 1969. For decades, he has remained an active guide and a source of inspiration for millions of young volunteers across the nation.

cal.event.roadSafety.title: Observation of National Road Safety Week
cal.event.roadSafety.desc: Comprehensive awareness campaign on traffic regulations, helmet & seatbelt compliance, and safe commuting practices.
cal.event.youthDay.title: Observation of National Youth Day (Swami Vivekananda Jayanti)
cal.event.youthDay.desc: Commemorating Swami Vivekananda's birth anniversary with youth rallies, debates, philosophy discussions, and leadership workshops.
cal.event.parakram.title: Parakram Diwas (Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose Birth Anniversary)
cal.event.parakram.desc: Tribute to Netaji with patriotic assemblies, seminars on his historic contribution to India's freedom struggle, and student elocution.
cal.event.girlChild.title: Observation of National Girl Child Day
cal.event.girlChild.desc: Awareness drive focusing on girl child education, health, gender equality, and Beti Bachao Beti Padhao initiatives.
cal.event.voters.title: Observation of National Voters' Day
cal.event.voters.desc: Electoral literacy club activities, voter pledge administration, and new voter registration assistance for eligible college students.
cal.event.republic.title: Celebration of Republic Day
cal.event.republic.desc: Ceremonial national flag hoisting, parade by NSS volunteers & NCC cadets, patriotic songs, and distribution of sweets.
cal.event.martyrs.title: Martyrs' Day (Shaheed Diwas) & Anti-Leprosy Day
cal.event.martyrs.desc: Observing 2 minutes of silence in memory of Mahatma Gandhi and freedom fighters, followed by leprosy awareness drive.
cal.event.cancer.title: Observation of World Cancer Day
cal.event.cancer.desc: Expert health seminar and poster presentation on early cancer detection, preventive lifestyles, and supporting survivors.
cal.event.motherLang.title: Observation of International Mother Language Day
cal.event.motherLang.desc: Celebrating linguistic diversity and indigenous heritage with multilingual poetry recitations, cultural presentations, and literary exhibitions.
cal.event.science.title: Observation of National Science Day
cal.event.science.desc: Commemorating the discovery of the Raman Effect with scientific outreach, science quizzes, exhibitions, and social innovation displays.
cal.event.womens.title: Celebration of International Women's Day
cal.event.womens.desc: Honoring womanhood, seminars on women leadership, legal rights awareness, and felicitating female achievers in community service.
cal.event.specialCamp.title: Annual 7-Day NSS Special Residential Camp (Adopted Village)
cal.event.specialCamp.desc: Flagship 7-day intensive rural camp in the adopted village featuring health surveys, literacy workshops, hygiene drives, plantation, and socio-economic profiling. [Note: Schedule is tentative and subject to change depending on situational requirements and academic calendar.]
cal.event.forestry.title: Observation of World Forestry Day (International Day of Forests)
cal.event.forestry.desc: Spreading awareness about forest conservation, urban afforestation, and planting saplings across the college botanical zone.
cal.event.water.title: Observation of World Water Day
cal.event.water.desc: Campaign on rainwater harvesting, ground water conservation, and anti-wastage water management workshops.
cal.event.tbDay.title: Observation of World Tuberculosis (TB) Day
cal.event.tbDay.desc: Public health awareness on tuberculosis symptoms, free government diagnostic facilities, DOTS therapy, and eradicating TB stigma.
cal.event.worldHealth.title: Observation of World Health Day
cal.event.worldHealth.desc: Free general health check-up camp, nutritional consultation, BMI screening, and health awareness session for students and staff.
cal.event.ambedkar.title: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Jayanti (Equality Day)
cal.event.ambedkar.desc: Commemorating the chief architect of the Indian Constitution with symposiums on social justice, human rights, and educational empowerment.
cal.event.earthDay.title: Observation of International Mother Earth Day
cal.event.earthDay.desc: Campus cleanliness campaign, plastic collection drive, distribution of cloth bags, and eco-friendly oath ceremony.
cal.event.labourDay.title: Observation of International Labour Day (May Day)
cal.event.labourDay.desc: Honoring college support staff and sanitary workers with tokens of gratitude and discussions on dignity of labour.
cal.event.tagore.title: Rabindranath Tagore Jayanti & World Red Cross Day
cal.event.tagore.desc: Celebrating Kabiguru Rabindranath Tagore's birth anniversary with cultural performances alongside first-aid training by Red Cross volunteers.
cal.event.royBirth.title: Observation of Raja Ram Mohan Roy Birth Anniversary
cal.event.royBirth.desc: Paying tribute to the pioneer of modern Indian Renaissance with educational talks on progressive social reforms.
cal.event.noTobacco.title: Observation of World No-Tobacco Day
cal.event.noTobacco.desc: Anti-tobacco street play (Nukkad Natak), rally, and awareness campaign against smoking and smokeless tobacco products.
cal.event.bicycle.title: Observation of World Bicycle Day
cal.event.bicycle.desc: Promoting green non-polluting transportation, fitness, and environmental health through a volunteer cycle rally.
cal.event.envDay.title: Observation of World Environment Day
cal.event.envDay.desc: Mega tree plantation drive, distribution of medicinal plants, zero-waste campus pledge, and environmental quiz competition.
cal.event.foodSafety.title: Observation of World Food Safety Day
cal.event.foodSafety.desc: Raising awareness on hygienic food handling, nutrition, prevention of foodborne diseases, and anti-food waste campaigns.
cal.event.childLabour.title: Observation of World Day Against Child Labour
cal.event.childLabour.desc: Advocating for children's fundamental right to education and protection against hazardous labour through community outreach.
cal.event.bloodDonor.title: Observation of World Blood Donor Day (Voluntary Blood Donation Camp)
cal.event.bloodDonor.desc: Mega voluntary blood donation camp organized in association with Asansol District Hospital Blood Center.
cal.event.yoga.title: Celebration of International Yoga Day
cal.event.yoga.desc: Demonstration of Common Yoga Protocol (CYP), pranayama exercises, and expert lecture on mental health and stress relief.
cal.event.doctors.title: Observation of National Doctor's Day & Van Mahotsav Celebration
cal.event.doctors.desc: Felicitation of local medical doctors for selfless public service along with commencement of Van Mahotsav plantation week.
cal.event.population.title: Observation of World Population Day
cal.event.population.desc: Seminars and debates on demographic trends, sustainable resource management, reproductive health, and gender equity.
cal.event.arannya.title: Observation of Arannya Saptaha (Forest Conservation Week)
cal.event.arannya.desc: State-level forest week celebration featuring sapling distribution, biodiversity documentation, and afforestation walks.
cal.event.kargil.title: Observation of Kargil Vijay Diwas
cal.event.kargil.desc: Saluting the valour and supreme sacrifice of Indian Armed Forces heroes with patriotic lectures and documentary screening.
cal.event.natureConservation.title: World Nature Conservation Day & World Hepatitis Day
cal.event.natureConservation.desc: Workshops on preserving natural biodiversity and preventing viral hepatitis through vaccination and sanitation awareness.
cal.event.swachhataPakhwada.title: Swachhata Pakhwada (Fortnight Cleanliness Campaign)
cal.event.swachhataPakhwada.desc: Ministry of Youth Affairs 15-day nationwide cleanliness drive: mass shramdaan, campus cleaning, single-use plastic elimination, and awareness rallies.
cal.event.quitIndia.title: Quit India Movement Day & Kranti Diwas
cal.event.quitIndia.desc: Remembering the martyrs of 1942 August Kranti with historical tributes and discussions on youth commitment to nation-building.
cal.event.intlYouthDay.title: Observation of International Youth Day
cal.event.intlYouthDay.desc: Interactive youth parliament, skill development workshops, and panel discussions on youth leadership in sustainable development goals.
cal.event.independence.title: Celebration of Independence Day
cal.event.independence.desc: National flag hoisting, parade, patriotic performances, distribution of sweets, and community service pledge.
cal.event.sadbhavana.title: Observation of Sadbhavana Diwas (National Harmony Day)
cal.event.sadbhavana.desc: Promoting national integration, communal harmony, and goodwill amongst people of all religions with the Sadbhavana Pledge.
cal.event.sports.title: Observation of National Sports Day (Major Dhyan Chand Jayanti)
cal.event.sports.desc: Fit India Movement activities, friendly sports matches, tug of war, and fitness pledge for physical wellness.
cal.event.nutritionWeek.title: Observation of National Nutrition Week (Rashtriya Poshan Maah)
cal.event.nutritionWeek.desc: Nutritional food exhibition, awareness on balanced diet, anemia prevention drives for female volunteers, and healthy recipe competitions.
cal.event.teachersDay.title: Celebration of Teachers' Day (Dr. S. Radhakrishnan Jayanti)
cal.event.teachersDay.desc: Felicitation of faculty members and Programme Officers by NSS volunteers, expressing deep gratitude for their mentorship and guidance.
cal.event.literacyDay.title: Observation of International Literacy Day
cal.event.literacyDay.desc: Adult literacy outreach, book donation drive, and distributing educational kits to underprivileged children in adopted villages.
cal.event.ozoneDay.title: Observation of World Ozone Day
cal.event.ozoneDay.desc: Educational seminars and poster displays on ozone layer protection, climate change countermeasures, and phasing out harmful chemicals.
cal.event.swachhata.title: Swachhata Hi Seva (SHS) Nationwide Campaign
cal.event.swachhata.desc: Intensive fortnight-long cleanliness drive, legacy waste removal, beautification of public spots, and citizen engagement.
cal.event.nssDay.title: Celebration of NSS Foundation Day (NSS Day)
cal.event.nssDay.desc: The golden day of NSS: Grand celebration commemorating the founding of National Service Scheme with oath taking, award recognition, and cultural fest.
cal.event.natBloodDay.title: National Voluntary Blood Donation Day
cal.event.natBloodDay.desc: Awareness rallies dispelling blood donation myths, motivating first-time donors, and donor registration drives.
cal.event.gandhi.title: Gandhi Jayanti & Swachh Bharat Diwas
cal.event.gandhi.desc: Paying homage to Mahatma Gandhi & Lal Bahadur Shastri with floral tributes, peace rallies, community shramdaan, and non-violence pledge.
cal.event.kalamJayanti.title: World Students' Day & National Innovation Day (Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Jayanti)
cal.event.kalamJayanti.desc: Commemorating the People's President Dr. Kalam with innovation ideathons, science exhibits, and inspirational youth seminars.
cal.event.unity.title: National Unity Day / Rashtriya Ekta Diwas (Sardar Patel Jayanti)
cal.event.unity.desc: Annual 'Run for Unity' mini-marathon, National Unity Pledge, and symposium on the integration of India by Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel.
cal.event.educationDay.title: Observation of National Education Day (Maulana Abul Kalam Azad Jayanti)
cal.event.educationDay.desc: Commemorating India's first Education Minister with seminars on modern pedagogical reforms, NEP awareness, and higher education access.
cal.event.childrenDiabetes.title: Children's Day & World Diabetes Awareness Day
cal.event.childrenDiabetes.desc: Engaging adopted village children with art contests and fun games alongside free blood glucose screening camp for senior citizens.
cal.event.constitution.title: Observation of National Constitution Day (Samvidhan Diwas)
cal.event.constitution.desc: Mass reading of the Preamble of the Constitution of India, legal awareness workshop on fundamental duties, and quiz competitions.
cal.event.aids.title: Observation of World AIDS Day
cal.event.aids.desc: Red Ribbon rally, expert session on HIV/AIDS prevention, stigma elimination, safe practices, and voluntary counseling awareness.
cal.event.pollutionControl.title: Observation of National Pollution Control Day
cal.event.pollutionControl.desc: Remembering the victims of Bhopal Gas Tragedy, workshops on industrial hazard prevention, air quality monitoring, and eco-auditing.
cal.event.volunteers.title: Observation of International Volunteers Day
cal.event.volunteers.desc: Celebrating the dedication of NSS student volunteers, sharing community impact testimonials, and presenting Volunteer of the Year awards.
cal.event.humanRights.title: Observation of Human Rights Day
cal.event.humanRights.desc: Advocating for universal human rights, dignity, freedom, and equal opportunity with interactive open forum and guest lectures.
